body.p: Reconsideration of the application is requested.
Claims 1-13 remain in the application. Claims 1-13 are subject to examination. Claims 1, 3 and 8 have been amended.
Under the heading "Claim Rejections - 35 USC § 112" on pages 2-3 of the above- identified Office Action, claims 1-13 have been rejected as being indefinite under 35 U.S.C. § 112, second paragraph.

With regards to item #4, claim 1 has been amended to recite "the at least one magnetization preparation RF pulse series being configured for inverting a longitudinal magnetization while encoding T2 contrast in a subsequent T1 recover"
as suggested by the examiner. Support for the change is found in paragraph [0018] of the instant application.

With regards to items 5 and 6, claim 1 has been amended to recite "wherein the inter-pulse duration is a time between first and last pulses, and GrfiglFured-for varying is varied by the MRI system in order to obtain different T2 weightings" as suggested by the examiner. Support for the change is found in paragraph [0013].
With regard to item #6, in claim 3, the "MRI parameter" was changed to "qMRI parameter" for consistency in the claim language.
In claim 8 a typo was corrected.

It is accordingly believed that claims 1-13 meet the requirements of 35 U.S.C. § 112, second paragraph. The above-noted changes to the claims are provided solely for clarification or cosmetic reasons. The changes are not provided for overcoming the prior art.
In view of the foregoing, reconsideration and allowance of claims 1-13 are solicited.
Please charge any other fees that might be due with respect to Sections 1.16 and
1.17 to the Deposit Account of Lerner Greenberg Stemer LLP, No. 12-1099.
